result:
Done. **The brief's premise was false: the measurement it asked me to dispatch already existed at n=13.** No device time spent.

**What I found first.** The brief asked for 5 fresh full-disc (`--base-iso` interactive, 1,673-capture) `Blend tests` runs. Thirteen are on disk — 6 nova + 7 thor, one `apk_sha`, one composition — dispatched by the merged lane.blendrace50 on 2026-09-19. I checked provenance at the request rather than the label (`request.base_iso` really is the interactive ISO) and the composition by set arithmetic: the 105-capture release set is a strict subset of the 1,673, leaving 1,568 `TestDetailed` captures.

**What was genuinely left to do.** blendrace50 was briefed to produce a *table and deliberately no rate*; this brief asks for the rate. So that is what PR #210 adds:

| device | runs | departures | capture-runs | rate | 95% Wilson | clean runs |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| nova | 6 | 21 | 10,038 | **0.2092%** | [0.137%, 0.320%] | **0 of 6** |
| thor | 7 | 1 | 11,711 | **0.0085%** | [0.0015%, 0.048%] | **6 of 7** |

Non-overlapping intervals, Fisher p = 0.0047 — so the pooled 0.10% is printed only to be refused. Per-capture spread: delta 0 to 58,183, median 12,288.

Two things that change how a #50 fix gets judged:

- **2 of 22 events moved capture bytes at an unchanged `differing` count.** `ab_compare` judges on that column, so it is blind to 9% of this race.
- The rule "no fix on single runs" splits: a whole-suite arm on nova has never once come back clean (model says 97%), but a targeted 4-leg prediction is under 1% per run, and pinning to thor is worth ~25×. The independence assumption is checked, not assumed (dispersion index 0.66; KS vs uniform p = 0.665).

**One thing I got wrong mid-task and withdrew.** A by-`apk_sha` inventory surfaced what looked like a free second-binary control (`a0fe6a75cfe2`, 2 nova runs, 1,673 captures, no missing PNGs). I ran the comparison, *then* found it is `1789963700-blendarm50-1474765` — the arm the owner killed, whose `ERROR` marker forbids scoring or comparing it. The comparison is withdrawn and its values appear nowhere in the PR, issue comment, or NOTES; what is recorded is the trap, under the identifier the next inventory will show it by.

**Status.** PR #210 is ready (not draft), body `Files:` matches the one-file diff, `nv2a_issues.toml` untouched, no prediction registered (analysis-only, per the brief). Preflight is green except the board-owned **coverage** gate, which fails on #189/#190's `blocked_on` text read from `origin/board` — my worktree's copy of those fields is empty and my diff is one file under `docs/lanes/`, so it is not attributable to this branch; `--allow-tracker` does not cover that gate. CI was `IN_PROGRESS` on both `build` checks when I finished; I did not poll it, since the PR is ready and the fold job gates on CI itself.

One judgement call worth your disagreement if you see it differently: I chose not to spend ~140 min of device despite holds being lifted, because at `--ref 49afee8889` it is duplication (projected nova interval [0.155, 0.290] — no conclusion moves) and at any newer ref the `apk_sha` differs, which `fulldisc_instability_50.py` excludes by its own control *and* a hardcoded constant. The newer-binary question is real but is a different measurement needing its own brief and pin.
